company.name: Kalulu Vision
company.shortDescription: An African technology and innovation company building intelligent digital solutions for real-world challenges.

about.overview: Kalulu Vision is a young technology and innovation company from Zambia. We design and build AI, software, data and IoT solutions for problems we see around us, and we teach the practical digital skills that help people build their own.
about.story: Kalulu is the clever hare of Zambian folklore: small, quick-thinking and always finding a way through difficult ground. That is the spirit we started with. Kalulu Vision grew out of hands-on work on applied AI and software projects in Zambia, from sign language recognition to curriculum-aligned tools for teachers, and out of the conviction that useful technology has to work in the conditions people actually live in: modest devices, limited bandwidth and local languages.
about.mission: To develop intelligent, accessible and impactful technology solutions that solve real-world problems.
about.vision: To become a leading African technology and innovation company creating solutions with global relevance.

values.title: Innovation
values.text: We look for new approaches, and test them against reality before we call them solutions.

values.title: Intelligence
values.text: We apply AI and data where they genuinely improve a decision or a service.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: Honest scoping, clear communication and no inflated claims.

values.title: Excellence
values.text: Careful engineering, thorough testing and work we are proud to hand over.

values.title: Collaboration
values.text: We build with the people who will use what we make.

values.title: Impact
values.text: Success is measured by the difference a solution makes, not by its complexity.

about.philosophy: Start with the problem, not the technology. Design for the devices, connectivity and languages people really have. Prove it works, then scale it.

approach.title: Listen first
approach.text: Understand the people, the context and the constraints before proposing anything.

approach.title: Prototype early
approach.text: Put a working version in front of users quickly and learn from how they use it.

approach.title: Validate with evidence
approach.text: Test against real data and real conditions, and report results honestly.

approach.title: Build to last
approach.text: Ship maintainable, documented systems and transfer the knowledge to run them.

about.africa: We believe Africa should build and own its technology, not only consume it. That means solutions designed for local infrastructure, support for African languages, and investing in the skills of the next generation of builders through our training programmes.

research.intro: Our research is applied: each question comes from a real problem, and each answer is tested in the field.

areas.title: Applied AI research
areas.text: Practical machine learning for problems with limited data and limited compute.

areas.title: African language technologies
areas.text: Tools for Bemba, Nyanja and other Zambian languages, designed to work offline.

areas.title: Accessibility and sign language
areas.text: Computer vision for Zambian Sign Language recognition, starting with building the first dataset.

areas.title: Intelligent automation
areas.text: Automating repetitive work in education and operations so people can focus on judgement.

areas.title: Data-driven innovation
areas.text: Turning public and organisational data into evidence that supports decisions.

areas.title: Emerging technologies
areas.text: IoT and edge systems for safety and environmental monitoring in mining communities.

services.title: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
services.summary: Practical AI that solves a specific problem, from prediction to computer vision and language tools.
services.intro: We help organisations identify where AI can genuinely add value, then design, train and deploy models that work with the data, devices and connectivity they actually have.
applications: Assistants grounded in your own documents

services.title: Software Development
services.summary: Reliable custom software engineered around your processes, built to be maintained.
services.intro: We design and build custom systems, from internal tools to full platforms, with clean architecture, tests and documentation so they keep working long after launch.

services.title: Web Application Development
services.summary: Fast, responsive web platforms that work well on everyday phones and slower connections.
services.intro: We build websites and web applications that load quickly, work on any screen and are easy for your team to update.

services.title: Mobile Application Development
services.summary: Android and cross-platform apps designed for everyday devices and intermittent connectivity.
services.intro: We build mobile apps that respect limited data, storage and battery, with offline-first designs where connectivity cannot be assumed.
offerings: Cross-platform apps for Android and iOS

services.title: Data Science & Analytics
services.summary: Turn raw data into clear evidence, dashboards and decisions.
services.intro: We clean, analyse and visualise data, apply sound statistics, and present findings in a form decision-makers can act on.

services.title: Internet of Things
services.summary: Connected sensors and devices that monitor conditions and raise alerts in real time.
services.intro: We design IoT systems end to end: sensors and microcontrollers, data transmission and the dashboards and alerts that make the data useful.
offerings: Data pipelines from field to cloud

services.title: Digital Transformation
services.summary: Move manual, paper-based processes to simple, dependable digital systems.
services.intro: We map how work is done today, find the steps that cost the most time or cause errors, and replace them with digital tools your team will actually use.

services.title: Technology Consulting & Research
services.summary: Independent advice and applied research to help you choose and validate the right technology.
services.intro: We help you evaluate options, test ideas with prototypes and evidence, and plan technology investments that fit your context.

products.name: Kalulu Vision Tech Lessons
products.description: Our training platform offers hands-on courses in programming, web development, AI and machine learning, data analytics, automation and IoT, with weekly, monthly and one-on-one plans, online or in person.

products.name: Educom AI
products.tagline: AI-assisted lesson planning for Zambian teachers.
products.description: An AI platform that helps teachers create curriculum-aligned lesson plans, quizzes, exams and marking schemes, grounded in curriculum documents. Submitted to the HEA Research and Innovation Digest 2026.

projects.title: Educom AI
projects.overview: AI-powered education technology that helps Zambian teachers prepare curriculum-aligned lessons and assessments.
projects.problem: Teachers spend hours preparing lesson plans and assessments that must align with the competency-based curriculum, often with limited resources.
projects.solution: A web platform that generates lesson plans, quizzes, exams and marking schemes, using retrieval over curriculum documents to keep output aligned, with PDF export and classroom tools.
projects.outcomes: Working prototype. Submitted to the HEA Research and Innovation Digest 2026.

projects.title: SignBridge
projects.problem: Deaf people who use Zambian Sign Language have almost no technology that understands their language, and no public dataset of Zambian signs exists to build it.
projects.solution: A real-time recognition system using hand-landmark tracking, beginning with a new dataset of roughly 30 to 50 Zambian signs recorded from 5 to 10 signers.
projects.outcomes: Planned research project; dataset design under way.

projects.title: TalkZed
projects.overview: Offline translation between Bemba, Nyanja and English.
projects.problem: Few digital tools support Bemba or Nyanja, and those that do usually need a reliable internet connection.
projects.solution: A mobile translation app designed to work offline on everyday phones, backed by a REST API and a PostgreSQL language database.

projects.title: MINEGUARD AI
projects.overview: An IoT and AI safety platform concept for artisanal and small-scale miners.
projects.problem: Artisanal and small-scale miners work with little safety monitoring, so hazards are often detected too late.
projects.solution: Connected sensors combined with AI-based risk detection to warn miners and supervisors about unsafe conditions early.
projects.outcomes: Concept developed for the Minepreneur Innovation Challenge.

projects.title: Tech Lessons Platform
projects.overview: The enrollment and subscription platform behind Kalulu Vision's technology training.
projects.problem: Running training enrollments over chat alone made it hard to track who had enrolled, paid and been activated.
projects.solution: A web platform with course and plan selection, automatic enrollment IDs, mobile money and bank payment instructions, and an admin dashboard to verify payments and manage subscriptions.
